title: Concept: Hex dependency with an open-ended requirement
description: mix.exs declares a `>=` requirement with no upper bound, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `>=` requirement with no upper bound.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through mix.exs (hex).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `>=` requirement with no upper bound.
